title: A release week
intro: Spec, Sass, the page, the events, the test, and the ship. This is what owning the frontend looks like.

items.title: Design spec
items.text: The frame arrives with type, space, and the states the page needs. Matching it is how the week starts.

items.title: Sass
items.text: Tokens and components stay coherent with that spec. The new page uses the system that is already in the codebase.

items.title: The page
items.text: A membership offer, a webinar registration, or a pricing UI lands as a real page, with the layout and the JavaScript that make the decision obvious.

items.title: The events
items.text: GTM dataLayer events record the view and the signup. UTM values are still on those events after a redirect.

items.title: Testing
items.text: The path is exercised before it ships: the redirect, the parameters, the event, and the layout on a phone.

items.title: Ship it
items.text: It goes out in the weekly release. The next offer reuses the page, the events, and the Sass.
